candidates.name: Checkmarx
candidates.description: Checkmarx is an AI-powered application security platform that provides a unified view of security risks across various attack surfaces in software development. Key features include hybrid scanning engines, real-time insights on code vulnerabilities, and the ability to identify emerging threats quickly, helping teams stay updated with evolving security needs.

It helps developers identify and fix vulnerabilities in their code, including open-source dependencies and hardcoded secrets, quickly identifies and remediation opportunities. Key features include automated security assessments, real-time reporting on potential threats, and the ability to automate security workflows across organizations to ensure compliance and reduce false positives. Semgrep also offers tools for managing security pipelines and creating secure guardrails before code ships.
candidates.rationale: Both offer developer-first application security tools for finding and remediating code and dependency vulnerabilities, targeting developers and application security teams.

Key features include real-time detection of vulnerabilities, secure MCP servers, automated remediation, and compliance with regulatory requirements, all designed to enhance security and efficiency in application development processes. The platform supports integration with various development workflows, including IDEs and containers, ensuring comprehensive protection against emerging threats like AI-based attacks.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused application security platforms that detect and remediate vulnerabilities within development workflows, targeting overlapping AppSec and engineering buyers.

The platform also offers real-time alerts and provides insights into code usage and deployment strategies to improve overall security posture.
candidates.rationale: Both provide developer-focused application security platforms that identify and automate remediation of vulnerabilities in code and open-source dependencies.
